text: Build custom Kubernetes APIs without writing controllers by configuring a pipeline of functions that return declarative configuration
quote: With Crossplane you don't have to write a controller. Instead you configure a pipeline of functions. The functions return declarative configuration that Crossplane should apply.

text: Write composition configuration in multiple languages, including YAML, KCL, Python, and Go
quote: Functions allow you to write your configuration in multiple languages, including YAML, KCL, Python, and Go.

text: Functions extend Crossplane with new ways to configure composition
quote: Functions - Functions extend Crossplane with new ways to configure composition

text: Providers connect Crossplane to external APIs so it can manage any resource anywhere
quote: Providers - Providers connect Crossplane to external APIs

text: Managed resources such as an RDS instance MR let Kubernetes manage AWS RDS instances
quote: there's an RDS instance MR that extends Kubernetes with the ability to manage AWS RDS instances.

text: Install Crossplane into your own Kubernetes cluster using the Helm chart
quote:
helm install crossplane \
--namespace crossplane-system \
--create-namespace crossplane-stable/crossplane

text: Preview the changes Crossplane will make to the cluster with helm install dry-run and debug options
quote: View the changes Crossplane makes to your cluster with the `helm install --dry-run --debug` options.

text: Install pre-release versions of Crossplane from the master Helm channel
quote: Install pre-release versions of Crossplane from the `master` Crossplane Helm channel.

text: Optional flag enables real-time compositions
quote: `--enable-realtime-compositions` Enable support for real time compositions.

text: Automatically protect Providers from deletion while they still have active managed resources (requires usages)
quote: Enable automatic protection of Providers from deletion when they have active managed resources. Requires `--enable-usages`.

text: Test and render Composition Functions locally without access to a cluster running Crossplane
quote: testing and rendering standalone Composition Functions without the need to access a Kubernetes cluster running Crossplane

text: CLI tooling for troubleshooting Compositions, Composite Resources, and Managed Resources
quote: troubleshooting Crossplane Compositions, Composite Resources and Managed Resources

text: CLI support for building, installing, updating, and pushing Crossplane packages
quote: building, installing, updating and pushing Crossplane Packages

text: Download specific Crossplane CLI versions or release branches via the XP_CHANNEL and XP_VERSION variables
quote: You can download different Crossplane CLI versions or different release branches with the `XP_CHANNEL` and `XP_VERSION` environmental variables.

text: Configurations are portable packages of Crossplane resources
quote: Configurations - Portable packages of Crossplane resources

text: Install Provider, Function, and Configuration packages into a Crossplane cluster
quote: Installing Crossplane enables the installation of Crossplane Provider, Function, and Configuration resources.

text: Assemble a platform faster from a library of existing components
quote: Use a library of components to assemble your platform faster

text: Image Configs give centralized control over package image configuration
quote: Image Configs - Centralized control of package image configuration

text: Verify package signatures through the ImageConfig API
quote: `--enable-signature-verification` Enable support for package signature verification via ImageConfig API.

text: Composite Resource Definitions define schemas for composite resources
quote: Composite Resource Definitions - Define schemas for composite resources

text: Design your own API schema and abstractions for how users interact with the control plane
quote: a highly configurable frontend that puts you in control of the schema of the declarative API it offers.

text: Environment Configs provide in-memory data stores for Compositions
quote: Environment Configs - In-memory data stores for Compositions

text: Composition Revisions manage changes to Compositions
quote: Composition Revisions - Manage changes to Compositions with revisions

text: Expose declarative APIs that humans, automation, and AI systems can safely act on
quote: Expose declarative APIs that humans, automation, and AI systems can safely act on

text: Declarative APIs make intent explicit, auditable, and machine-readable
quote: With Crossplane you can build a platform around your own opinions using declarative APIs that make intent explicit, auditable, and and machine-readable

text: Inherits Kubernetes reliability and security features like RBAC for orchestrating non-container resources
quote: Crossplane builds on the class leading Kubernetes control plane, extending its battle hardened reliability and security features like Role Based Access Control (RBAC) to orchestrate everything

text: Automatically detects drift from the desired state and corrects it
quote: If your software ever drifts from your desired state, the control plane automatically corrects the drift.

text: New features ship behind feature flags, with alpha features off and beta features on by default
quote: Crossplane introduces new features behind feature flags. By default alpha features are off. Crossplane enables beta features by default.

text: Works with existing Kubernetes tools because it is built on Kubernetes
quote: It's built on Kubernetes, so it works with all the Kubernetes tools you already use.

text: Modular design lets you use all four components or only the ones you need
quote: You can use all four components to build your control plane, or pick only the ones you need.

text: Cache composition function responses to improve performance
quote: `--enable-function-response-cache` Enable caching of composition function responses to improve performance.

text: Put policies, permissions, and guardrails behind a custom API layer so consumers can self-serve infrastructure
quote: Encapsulate policies, permissions, and other guardrails behind a custom API layer to enable consumers... to self-service without needing to become an infrastructure expert.
